step1_analysis.description: A high-speed unity-gain buffer consisting of a differential amplifier (XM1-XM4) and a source follower (XM5) in a unity-gain feedback loop. A replica source follower (XM5_PRIME) provides an isolated output to drive subsequent stages without loading the feedback loop.

paper_reference.title: A Burst-Mode Receiver for 1.25-Gb/s Ethernet PON With AGC and Internally Created Reset Signal

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the closed-loop buffer.

sky130_expected.calculation: Unity gain feedback forces V(OUT) ≈ V(IN), so gain is ~1 V/V or 0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The circuit is configured as a voltage follower.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm1 / (2*pi*C_N5). With I_tail=40uA, gm1~333uS, C_N5~55fF, GBW ≈ 960 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the 1 GHz operating frequency reported in the paper for the 1.25 Gb/s standard.
Based on estimated bias currents required to achieve 1 GHz bandwidth.

trise.description: Rise time of the output signal.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly related to the bandwidth of the buffer.

delay.description: Propagation delay from input to output at 50% crossing.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical delay for a single-stage amplifier in 180nm technology.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, -3dB bandwidth, power consumption, rise time, and propagation delay of the active feedback buffer.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Active Feedback Buffer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm5_prime=5u L_xm5_prime=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0.8 1.0 0.1n 50p 50p 400p 1n)

* Short N4 to N5 to close the feedback loop
Vshort N4 N5 0

* Bias currents (ideal sources for testing)
I_tail N1 0 40u
I_N3 N3 0 20u
I_OUT OUT 0 20u

* Load capacitance
Cload OUT 0 50f

* DUT
XM1 N2 IN N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5 VDD N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM5_PRIME VDD N4 OUT GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5_prime} w={W_xm5_prime}
XM3 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 N5 N3 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM4 N5 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 20 1Meg 10G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=-3 fall=1

tran 10p 3n
meas tran trise trig v(OUT) val=0.85 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.95 rise=1
meas tran tfall trig v(OUT) val=0.95 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.85 fall=1
meas tran delay trig v(IN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 rise=1

quit
.endc
.end
